Subject: MAP + test-harness: success criteria & closure lane (Kite Health)

Hi Daniel / Priya —

Really appreciated yesterday's demo. As promised, attached is a first-pass mutual action plan (Kite_MAP_v1.xlsx) plus a lightweight test harness (Kite_eval-testlist.csv) that maps the evaluation scenarios you mentioned to measurable signals.

This draft focuses on three outcome buckets we talked about: reliability (99th pct token latency), fidelity (precision/recall on annotated examples), and integration (API ops + keys/telemetry). High level ask: please review the acceptance tests in column C and mark owners so we can align on a go/no-go by the pilot close date.

Key dates we propose:
- Start smoke / integration: 2026-06-28
- Full evaluation window: 2026-06-28 -> 2026-07-08 (10 business days)
- Close decision/rollout recommendation: by EOD 2026-07-09

Immediate asks for your team:
1) Confirm the list of acceptance tests you require (small edits in the attached .csv)
2) Share any compliance evidence needs that would block a Dedicated deployment (if so, we’ll loop Security)
3) Confirm API keys and one example test dataset to run the first 24h smoke tests

Owners from our side: Ben (keeps test harness and runs smoke), Marcus (runtime / perf tuning), Lauren (commercial / contract readiness). I’ll be the executive sponsor and will coordinate cutover approvals.

Attachments: Kite_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 74KB), Kite_eval-testlist.csv (CSV, 18KB)

Thanks,
Evelyn

Hi Daniel — happy to join the 9:30am PT sync on 2026-06-28 (I had it booked; moved to keep this thread consistent). Quick answers to your asks below and notes for the team: 

1) Latency targets (pilot profile, avg seq len ~180):
   - p50 token latency: <= 6ms
   - p95 token latency: <= 32ms
   - p99 token latency: <= 120ms (these are conservative; Marcus can tighten after telemetry)

2) Fidelity additions — included. For the anonymized notes test we suggest 200 samples (increase for statistical confidence) and will provide a small evaluation harness to automate label comparison. The privacy check will be added as a binary pass/fail auto-check in the test harness (we'll run regex-based redaction checks and a sampling manual review).

3) Procurement / contract: Lauren — please drop a one-page procurement lane with dates and contacts (Priya is copied). We can provide draft T&Cs for your procurement team by 2026-07-07 to meet your requested 2-day buffer.

Next steps and owners (updated):
- Ben: orchestrate smoke tests 6/28-6/29, deliver initial telemetry and preliminary perf tuning by 6/30
- Marcus: runtime configs + quantization profile suggestions by 6/30 (to help hit p95 target)
- Lauren: procurement lane doc and initial T&Cs by 7/07
- Daniel / Priya: return annotated acceptance tests and designate owner for anonymized dataset by 6/30

I'll attach the updated harness after the 9:30am sync (small change set).
